facts.fact: Starlink sells residential kits in Nigeria; on 15 September 2025 new orders were paused in parts of Lagos and Abuja as sold out, with waitlist deposits only, after a nationwide order suspension from November 2024 to late June 2025.
Subscribers: 59,509 at 2025-03, per NCC data (Starlink active users, Q1 2025), down from 65,564 in Q4 2024.
Subscribers: 65,564 at 2024-12, per NCC data (Starlink active users, Q4 2024).
